# H&M

6 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit), 4 advanced (5) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

H&M catalog data: keyword search and suggestions, store listings by country, the supported countries/languages table, the category tree, and per-product supplier and factory disclosure (useful for supply-chain and ESG work, not just merchandising).

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/hm/categories - 1 credit (standard)

Returns H&M's website navigation tree: department nodes with child categories, hrefs, and tracking labels. The upstream has no language parameter; the dump is the US tree (/en_us/ hrefs). This is reference taxonomy, not a product listing.

**Use when** Use it as reference taxonomy. It is not a product listing and has no language parameter (US tree).
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data`, `{ menuItems, serviceItems, siteStructure }` (inferred from a sample): `menuItems`, `serviceItems.links`, `serviceItems.numberOfVisibleServiceItems`, `siteStructure`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/hm/categories" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/hm/countries - 1 credit (standard)

Returns H&M's market list grouped by region, each country with its two-letter locale, storefront languages, and storefront URL. Use the two-letter locale as query on GET /v1/hm/stores. Search language is a different code (en_us, not us).

**Use when** you want to discover country codes for stores, or to see which languages a market offers.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data`, `{ backgroundImage, regions }` (inferred from a sample): `backgroundImage`, `regions`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/hm/countries" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/hm/product/suppliers - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns the manufacturing countries, supplier names, factory names, addresses, and worker-count bands H&M publishes for one product. Pass the product id from GET /v1/hm/search. A product id the origin cannot resolve fails the call (it is not an empty list). language does not change the factory list.

**Use when** you already have a product id from search and want the supply-chain record H&M publishes for that article.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `product_id` (required) - H&M product id, the digits in a product page URL: www2.hm.com/en_us/productpage.0963662139.html is product id 0963662139. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/hm/search. · e.g. `0963662139`
- `language` (optional, string) - Catalogue locale as language_region, for example en_us, en_gb, de_de, fr_fr. Omit for the US catalogue. This is not the two-letter locale from GET /v1/hm/countries.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data`, `{ countries, responseStatusCode }` (inferred from a sample): `countries`, `responseStatusCode`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/hm/product/suppliers" \
  --data-urlencode "product_id=0963662139" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/hm/search - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns one page of H&M products for a keyword, 36 per page by default, each with product id, name, brand, current and original price, images, colour, sizes, availability, and the product page URL. Sort by relevance (default), newest, price_low, or price_high. Pass language to switch catalogue (en_us default, en_gb, de_de, fr_fr). filters is an H&M facet string from the live payload (colorWithNames, sizes, fits); a guessed filter that the origin cannot parse fails the call rather than returning an empty page. There is no product-detail endpoint on this surface: feed a returned product id into GET /v1/hm/product/suppliers for factory data.

**Use when** you want to search the H&M catalogue by keyword. Paginate with cursor until a short page. There is no product-detail endpoint; feed a product id into product/suppliers for factory data.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 36/page by default, max 36; set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/36) x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keyword, for example t-shirts, jeans, dress. · e.g. `t-shirts`
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-36) - Products per page, 1 to 36. Default 36. Values above 36 are clamped; 100 crashes the origin.
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: relevance | newest | price_low | price_high) - Result ordering: relevance (default), newest, price_low, or price_high.
- `language` (optional, string) - Catalogue locale as language_region, for example en_us, en_gb, de_de, fr_fr. Omit for the US catalogue. This is not the two-letter locale from GET /v1/hm/countries.
- `filters` (optional, string) - H&M facet filter string. Example: colorWithNames:black_000000. Combine groups with || and values inside a group with |. Facet ids are listed on every search payload under searchHits.facets.

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/hm/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=t-shirts" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/hm/search/suggestions - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns H&M search autocomplete suggestions for a partial query, the same terms the search box shows. Pass language to localise (kleid on de_de returns kleider / kleid damen).

**Use when** you want to expand a keyword before calling search.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - Fixed-window autocomplete: upstream returns a single non-cursored suggestion list.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Partial search query to autocomplete, for example tshirt. · e.g. `tshirt`
- `language` (optional, string) - Catalogue locale as language_region, for example en_us, en_gb, de_de, fr_fr. Omit for the US catalogue. This is not the two-letter locale from GET /v1/hm/countries.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ query }` (inferred from a sample): `query`.

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/hm/search/suggestions" \
  --data-urlencode "query=tshirt" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/hm/stores - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns every H&M store in a market: store code, name, full address, phone, coordinates, and weekly opening hours. Pass the two-letter country code as query (us, gb, de). This is a country dump, not a near-me search, and it is a single page. An unknown country code returns an empty list.

**Use when** you have a two-letter country code (us, gb, de). This is a country dump, not a near-me search.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - Upstream /stores returns the full country dump in one payload (478 US stores, 181 GB, live 2026-09-02) and exposes no page parameter.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Two-letter H&M market code, for example us, gb, de. Use GET /v1/hm/countries to list markets. This is a country dump, not a near-me search. · e.g. `us`
- `language` (optional, string) - Catalogue locale as language_region, for example en_us, en_gb, de_de, fr_fr. Omit for the US catalogue. This is not the two-letter locale from GET /v1/hm/countries.

**Response** `PlaceList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/PlaceList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.latitude` |  |
| `place.longitude` |  |
| `place.phone` |  |
| `place.ext.status` |  |

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/hm/stores" \
  --data-urlencode "query=us" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
